title: Sleepy Creek Campground

services.name: Lot Rentals
services.desc: Lots are available for rent at Sleepy Creek starting at $1200 a year. We have 200 lots that rent out year-round with many returning customers. Sites are limited stay, no living at the campground is allowed. Availability is limited and there may be a waiting list. Lots average around 40x100ft. Each lot has access to its own electric meter. Electricity is to be arranged by the tenant through Potomac Edison. Water delivery can be requested through the campground. Water supply service to be paid for by the lot tenant. Septic services can be handled by outside companies. Mayes Septic & Port-a-Pot can provide this service. Scheduling and payment is provided by the lot

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Home of Sleepy Creek Campground on the Potomac, where Sleepy Creek meets the Potomac River, in Morgan County West.
